description: This file contains a shell script that performs a series of automated tests related to Git submodule referencing, especially focusing on the use of --reference, --dissociate, and --reference-if-able options. It sets up multiple repositories, adds submodules with references, and verifies that alternates are properly used or skipped under various conditions, ensuring correct submodule cloning and updating behavior within a Git project.

methods.name: test_alternate_is_used
methods.description: Checks if the Git objects info/alternates file has the expected content, verifying the use of alternates for a given repository path.

methods.name: check_that_two_of_three_alternates_are_used
methods.description: Ensures that two specific repositories' alternates are used while the nested one is not, verifying correct setup in nested submodules with alternates.
